Maintenance

Our commercial maintenance services help keep your property safe, functional, and looking its best. From routine upkeep and repairs to emergency fixes, our responsive team delivers reliable, high-quality workmanship to minimize downtime and keep your business running smoothly.

Our Services

We've Got Your Maintenance Covered

Reliable commercial maintenance services to keep your property safe, functional, and looking its best.

Buildings need a little TLC to stay in top shape—and that's where we come in. Whether it's fixing a leaky ceiling, touching up paint, or handling regular upkeep, our crew is ready to keep your space running smoothly. From retail shops to offices and restaurants, we make sure everything stays safe, clean, and looking great—so you don't have to worry about it.

Our maintenance services are designed for property managers, landlords, and business owners who need reliable, responsive support to keep their commercial spaces in excellent condition. We understand that downtime costs money, which is why we prioritize quick response times and quality workmanship.

What's included

  • Initial consultation and concept development
  • Space planning and design
  • Permit acquisition and code compliance
  • Cost estimation and budget management
  • Complete construction and finishing
  • Final inspection and handover

Frequently Asked Questions

Ridgeway Services & Construction primarily serves clients throughout the Greater Toronto Area, Toronto, and Southern Ontario. However, our team has successfully completed projects beyond these areas, including locations across Ontario and Eastern Canada. Whether your project is nearby or requires travel, we're committed to bringing the same level of quality, communication, and expertise to every build.

Ridgeway Services & Construction specializes in commercial construction, renovations, tenant improvements, and design-build projects across a variety of industries. We've worked with businesses in childcare, retail, restaurants, offices, and professional spaces to bring their ideas from concept through completion.

Our team takes a collaborative approach, working closely with clients and partners to deliver high-quality spaces that meet their needs, timelines, and goals.

Yes, Ridgeway Services & Construction offers both design and construction services. Our team works closely with clients to create comprehensive solutions tailored to their needs and goals.

Yes. Ridgeway offers ongoing maintenance and support services after project completion. Our team helps clients maintain their commercial spaces through routine upkeep, repairs, and improvements, ensuring their investment continues to perform well over time.
